title: Affine derived base-change comparison map and its localization
statement: Let R\to A and R\to R' be ring maps and put A'=A\otimes_R R'. For a complex M^\bullet of A-modules [def-pc-derived-category] there is a canonical comparison morphism c:M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R'\to M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A' in D(R') (Stacks, More on Algebra, equation comparison-map): it is E^\bullet\otimes_R R'\to P^\bullet\otimes_A A' for a K-flat complex P^\bullet of A-modules representing M^\bullet and a quasi-isomorphism E^\bullet\to P^\bullet from a K-flat complex E^\bullet of R-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] [def-pc-base-change]. For every i the cohomology modules H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R') and H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A') carry natural A'-module structures (the second from the complex of A'-modules P^\bullet\otimes_A A') for which H^i(c) is A'-linear. For every prime \mathfrak q' of A', with images \mathfrak q of A and \mathfrak p',\mathfrak p of R',R, there are natural isomorphisms H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R')\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}\cong H^i(M^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'})\otimes_{A_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'}}A'_{\mathfrak q'} and H^i(M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A')\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'}\cong H^i(M^\bullet_{\mathfrak q}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_{\mathfrak q}}A'_{\mathfrak q'}), under which H^i(c)\otimes_{A'}A'_{\mathfrak q'} is the map induced by the comparison morphism for R_{\mathfrak p}\to A_{\mathfrak q}, R_{\mathfrak p}\to R'_{\mathfrak p'} followed by base change along A_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{R_{\mathfrak p}}R'_{\mathfrak p'}\to A'_{\mathfrak q'}.
